case_name: Smt. Payel Mukherjee (Dey) vs Gopinath Dey
facts_of_case: Matrimonial appeal filed by the wife/appellant challenging the decree of dismissal of the suit for divorce. The wife/appellant has filed an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act praying for condonation of delay.

legal_principles.principle: The appeal was filed within the prescribed period of limitation.
legal_principles.held: According to her, the instant appeal was filed beyond the prescribed period of limitation. However, it is reported by the Additional Stamp Reporter that the appeal was filed within the prescribed period of time.

legal_principles.principle: The application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act filed by the appellant/applicant is redundant.
legal_principles.held: The said application being CAN 2581 of 2015 is thus dismissed by treating the same as withdrawn.

outcome.final_order: The application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act filed by the appellant/applicant is dismissed. The appeal is allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for condonation of delay in a family court
advising on the limitation period for filing an appeal against a divorce decree
preparing a response to an application for stay of proceedings
